name: tmux-lanes
description: Let a coordinating agent run real, interactive Claude Code workers itself instead of asking a human to open windows. Each lane is a live TUI session in detached tmux, started on its own git worktree with a per-lane Stop hook so the lead learns deterministically when a worker stops talking; the lead watches for change, pokes stalled lanes, records decisions on the issue before delivering them, and refuses to reap a lane whose work is not merged.
